name: SDB Explorer
description: Inspect Microsoft shim databases and the application fixes they install.
about: A shim database describes compatibility fixes Windows applies to a program when it runs, matched against the executable by name, size and other attributes. Custom databases can be registered on a system to attach arbitrary behaviour to a chosen program, which is why they are worth examining rather than assuming to be Microsoft's own. SDB Explorer parses a .sdb file and shows the executables it matches, the conditions each match depends on, and the fixes or patches applied when it does — including the raw patch bytes where one is present. Both the shipped system databases and custom ones can be read.
